name: ZCA_INTG_ENDPOINTS
description: This table is used to store the registered target information such as endpoint,resource catalog endpoint,credential key and app name.

columns.name: INTG_ENDPOINT_ID
columns.description: This column is the primary key of the table holding unique value.

columns.name: TARGET_APP_NAME
columns.description: This column holds the target application name used in the integration.

columns.name: TARGET_METADATA_URL
columns.description: This column specifies the URL for target resource catalog.

columns.name: TARGET_METADATA_CONTENT_TYPE
columns.description: This column holds the rest content-type for target resource catalog.

columns.name: TARGET_URI_SPEC_VERSION
columns.description: This column holds the open API spec version of target resource.

columns.name: TARGET_URL
columns.description: This column specifies the URL for target endpoint to be invoked.

columns.name: REFERENCE_NAME
columns.description: This column holds the reference name of the object for which data is to be synchronized.

columns.name: CREDENTIAL_REF_KEY
columns.description: This column holds the key which will be referred in credential store.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: This column specifies the description of the target application used in the integration.

columns.name: TARGET_METADATA_HEADERS
columns.description: This column specifies the headers used when calling the target endpoint API.

columns.name: SECURITY_TYPE
columns.description: This column specifies the authorization type for the target endpoint.

columns.name: CREDENTIAL_KEY
columns.description: This column specifies the credential store key that references the authentication details of the target endpoint.

columns.name: TOKEN_GEN_URL
columns.description: This column specifies the URL for the token generation endpoint. This column is only populated for certain authentication types.

columns.name: TOKEN_GEN_HEADERS
columns.description: This column specifies the headers used when calling the token generation endpoint.
